research_mode: official GOV.UK primary statistical releases and methodology only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel result, exact incident location, candidate value, local risk score or business result claimed

sources.name: Pf Force Scope
verified_claims: The police-use-of-firearms release covers the 43 territorial police forces in England and Wales.
limitations: It does not represent every UK police body or every armed security activity.

sources.name: Pf Operation Definition
verified_claims: A police firearms operation is an authorised deployment of armed officers where firearm use may be necessary to protect officers or others.
limitations: An authorised deployment does not mean a firearm was fired.

sources.name: Pf Arv Definition
verified_claims: An armed response vehicle is adapted to transport trained armed officers and specialist equipment rapidly to incidents.
limitations: An ARV operation count is not a count of vehicles, officers or shots.

sources.name: Pf Discharge Measure
verified_claims: The release counts incidents in which police firearms were discharged at persons.
limitations: Incident counts are not the number of firearms fired or shots discharged.

sources.name: Pf Officer Snapshot
verified_claims: Armed-officer statistics are a snapshot as at 31 March 2026.
limitations: A snapshot does not measure staffing throughout the whole year.

sources.name: Pf Useforce Noncomparability
verified_claims: Separate police-use-of-force statistics include wider firearm tactics and are not directly comparable because definitions and collection differ.
limitations: Figures from the two series must not be merged without harmonisation.

sources.name: Pf Operations 2026
verified_claims: There were 17,584 police firearms operations in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: The national total does not establish local danger or parcel-level risk.

sources.name: Pf Arv Share 2026
verified_claims: Ninety-three percent of firearms operations in the year ending March 2026 involved an ARV.
limitations: The ARV share is a subcategory proportion, not a measure of firearm discharge.

sources.name: Pf Discharge 2026
verified_claims: There were nine incidents in which police discharged firearms at persons in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: Small annual counts are volatile and should not be converted into precise local probabilities.

sources.name: Pf Deployable Definition
verified_claims: Operationally deployable armed officers exclude officers absent through sickness or on restricted duties.
limitations: Total armed officers and deployable armed officers are different measures.

sources.name: Pf Stooddown Exclusion
verified_claims: Operations where officers were stood down before deployment are excluded from firearms-operation totals.
limitations: Excluded stand-downs must not be inferred from published totals.

sources.name: Pf Guarding Exclusion
verified_claims: VIP protection, armed prisoner escorts, airport patrols, guarding duties and routine patrols are excluded from firearms-operation totals.
limitations: The statistics do not measure all armed-officer activity.

sources.name: Pf Other Discharge Exclusion
verified_claims: Accidental discharges, animal destruction, police training and tyre deflations are excluded from the operation discharge measure.
limitations: Excluded discharge types must not be added to incidents fired at persons.

sources.name: Pf Arv Subcategory
verified_claims: Operations involving ARVs are a subcategory where the first or only response was by an ARV.
limitations: All firearms operations include the ARV subcategory, so the figures must not be added together.

sources.name: Pf Incident Not Shots
verified_claims: A discharge incident count does not equal the number of weapons fired or shots fired.
limitations: Shot volume cannot be derived from incident totals.

sources.name: Pf Lesslethal Exclusion
verified_claims: Discharge-at-person figures exclude less-lethal weapons such as attenuating energy projectiles and conducted energy devices.
limitations: The series is not a complete measure of all force tactics.

sources.name: Pf City Rate Exclusion
verified_claims: City of London is excluded from per-100,000 force comparisons because its population estimate is below 100,000.
limitations: Rate tables do not provide a complete comparison for every force area.

sources.name: Pf Revision Policy
verified_claims: The latest release incorporates revisions to previous-year figures submitted by forces.
limitations: Historical values must be versioned because later releases can supersede them.

sources.name: Pf Covid Definition Issue
verified_claims: Some forces interpreted operationally deployable differently during COVID-19 and could not fully comply with the required definition because of system restrictions.
limitations: Pre-2022 deployability comparisons may contain small inconsistencies.

sources.name: Pf Qa Adr
verified_claims: The data are mandatory Annual Data Requirement returns and undergo variance, completeness, duplicate and validity checks with all forces.
limitations: Mandatory collection and QA do not make the data suitable for exact-address inference.
